task: order groceries for delivery on a grocery delivery service (Instacart, Walmart, Amazon Fresh): search for items, compare options and prices, add to cart, pick a delivery window, check out; complete when an order confirmation with the delivery window is on screen. Surface pinned: the web or mobile-app interface of a grocery delivery service — not in-store shopping footage or a recipe/meal-prep video. Variants: ordering for store/curbside pickup, restaurant takeout, receiving the delivery at the door, and meal-kit subscriptions do not belong.

tree.label: Order groceries online
tree.note: do 1 and 2 in the order the surface forces - their walls can fire late instead: the auth wall at the first add (KnrH), the address wall at the first add (uu4z) or at checkout, where it ends the run (XBsT). 3 before any shopping on reservation-first platforms (rPnc, Z5bc, XQAu), from the cart on Walmart (w7tc, hSsk), inside 7 elsewhere. repeat 4 per item; 5 loops back into 4 while a threshold blocks (KnrH, uWX7, XBsT). 6 wherever the platform asks - at an add (qBwH), in the cart (rPnc), as a checkout page (UtCH, _5jL, N5-3), or re-entered from 8 right after placing (rX1S, bpci, QeWn). then 7 - seven of twenty-four get through it. 8 on placed orders; 9 on the four that reach a delivered state on screen.
